Full-depth fan-out: family "Material operations — CAW procedures and secret projection". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Moves: the installed-world procedure holds (proof is a fixed procedure), the material operations gather (the material API receiving work), and the secret-projection session prompt ruptures (repel — a secret's origin and projection is a boundary record; 3D here: z is the projection's depth — origin nearest, cross-machine placement deepest).

3D: the member's depth is situated placement in a room — z is the Workcell's own here-ness: the workstation face nearest, the placed world deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=placed bounds hold, gather=material gathered, vortex=lifecycle turns, rupture=the demand cuts in, settle=the room at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the placed world breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words — placement is the Workcell's native grammar.
